headline: TOL Gases Rights Issue Shares List on DSE, Taking Total to 69 Million
summary: TOL Gases listed 11,501,193 rights issue shares on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange on 17 November 2026. Its ordinary share count rises to about 69 million. Proceeds will fund a carbon dioxide plant due to start in Q2 2027.
why: A rights issue lets existing shareholders buy new shares, raising capital for expansion. The Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange is Tanzania's main venue for equity trading.
